column2: Legal-document storage after type confirmation (RWB-E1-032 CLAR-008): when a low-confidence stored document is confirmed to a write_once type, the confirm step re-stores the file through the published DocumentStorage interface into the write-once container rwb-docs-legal at {caseId}/{documentId}/v{docVersion}, moves storage_ref, writes a DOCATT audit entry naming the container and the confirming user, and keeps the standard-container object for evidence under the rwb-docs versioning policy. column2: Intake-agent promotion grammar ruled (RWB-E1-061 CLAR-001): promotion_conditions holds exactly one clause per version - {"metric":"AGREEMENT_RATE","operator":"GTE","threshold":<number 0..1, two decimals>,"scope":"EVERY_LABEL_KEY"} - in prose, "agreement at least <threshold> for every gap type"; any other metric, operator, scope or a second clause is refused at load; watch_measures hold ACCEPTANCE_RATE (GTE), CORRECTION_RATE (GTE) and FALLBACK_RATE (LTE) rows for reporting and do not gate the proposal; fallback_rule "rule result per R-UNI-32" is required. column2: D-RCV-35 ruled: the Recovery Workbench takes no inbound source data. All source data lands in the ACE database through ACE's ingestion (U1); the ACE team owns the new ACE tables and columns, raised once in RWB-ACE-001 (U2); Workbench-only fields go into 1:1 extension tables keyed by ACE business keys and no existing ACE table is altered by the Workbench (U3); the recovery module reads ACE only through SELECT-only recovery.v_ace_* views, with no foreign key into ACE because ACE cascades deletes on account (U4); Excel and SharePoint trackers leave system scope and are retired through the Cutover plan (U5). This supersedes DT12, DL06 option A and DL12 option A, amends DL20 to name ACE as the route for customer facts, and amends D-RCV-29 because the sys_objects and sys_fields counts change.
column4: Recovery tech lead with the data architect; ACE team lead for RWB-ACE-001 and DL43
column5: Supersedes DT12, DL06 option A and DL12 option A. Amends DL20 (customer facts come from ACE, which ingests them from SCBPDM and the core bank) and D-RCV-29 (122 sys_objects, 1,366 sys_fields). 20 tables and 243 fields leave the schema; 4 extension tables and 30 recovery.v_ace_* views are added; the schema is 92 tables and 122 sys_objects. ADR-010 supersedes ADR-005. DL43 is open with the ACE team lead, needed by 2026-11-21.
